"""Report charts rendered off-screen with matplotlib (Agg backend)."""
import warnings

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
from matplotlib import cbook, cm  # noqa: E402
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap, to_hex  # noqa: E402

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=cbook.mplDeprecation)

BRAND = ListedColormap(["#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3"], name="brand")
cm.register_cmap(name="brand", cmap=BRAND)


def palette(n, name="viridis"):
    """``n`` hex colours sampled from a registered colormap."""
    cmap = cm.get_cmap(name, n)
    return [to_hex(cmap(i)) for i in range(n)]


def line_chart(series, style="seaborn-whitegrid"):
    plt.style.use(style)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3), dpi=50)
    for label, values in series.items():
        ax.plot(values, label=label)
    legend = ax.legend(ncol=2)
    labels = [handle.get_label() for handle in legend.legendHandles]
    return fig, labels


def to_pixels(fig):
    """The rendered figure as an (h, w, 3) uint8 array."""
    fig.canvas.draw()
    width, height = fig.canvas.get_width_height()
    pixels = np.frombuffer(fig.canvas.tostring_rgb(), dtype=np.uint8)
    plt.close(fig)
    return pixels.reshape(height, width, 3)

"""Statistical figures: contour levels and box plots."""
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402


def contour_count(levels=3):
    """How many contour levels a radial surface is drawn with."""
    x, y = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1, 1, 20), np.linspace(-1, 1, 20))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    contours = ax.contour(x, y, x ** 2 + y ** 2, levels=levels)
    n = len(contours.collections)
    plt.close(fig)
    return n


def box_medians(groups):
    """Median per group, read back from the drawn box plot."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    parts = ax.boxplot(list(groups.values()), labels=list(groups))
    medians = [float(line.get_ydata()[0]) for line in parts["medians"]]
    names = [tick.get_text() for tick in ax.get_xticklabels()]
    plt.close(fig)
    return dict(zip(names, medians))

from app import charts


def test_palette():
    colours = charts.palette(3)
    assert colours == ["#440154", "#21918c", "#fde725"]


def test_brand_palette_is_registered():
    assert charts.palette(3, "brand") == ["#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3"]


def test_line_chart_legend():
    fig, labels = charts.line_chart({"north": [1, 3, 2], "south": [2, 2, 4]})
    assert labels == ["north", "south"]
    pixels = charts.to_pixels(fig)
    assert pixels.shape == (150, 200, 3)
    assert pixels.dtype.name == "uint8"

def heatmap_meta(z):
    """How a matrix is drawn: the image's interpolation and colour limits."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    image = ax.imshow(z)
    meta = {"interpolation": image.get_interpolation(),
            "clim": [float(v) for v in image.get_clim()]}
    plt.close(fig)
    return meta

notes: Old: matplotlib 3.6.3 on Python 3.11 with numpy 1.26.4 (3.6 has no wheels for Python 3.12 and needs numpy<2). New: 3.10.9 with numpy 2.3.5 on Python 3.12 (the 3.9/3.10 migration; 3.11 removes cm.get_cmap outright). The Agg backend is set in the app, nothing is shown. Legend.legendHandles and ContourSet.collections are instance attributes on 3.6.3 (not on the class), so an API probe of the class cannot see them; tostring_rgb has no same-format successor (buffer_rgba is RGBA). The style rename is data (a string argument), so it is BEHAVIOR. cm.get_cmap and boxplot(labels=) still work on 3.10 (DEPRECATED); cm.get_cmap warns on both sides. The module-level warnings.filterwarnings(..., category=cbook.mplDeprecation) is the common real use of that alias. numpy is a direct dependency too (frombuffer, meshgrid), so its 1.26 -> 2.3 delta shows up in the plan; the calls used are unchanged.
